output.name: testify
output.purpose: Create and validate a distinct behavioral test for a concrete observed risk; use static constraints first.

criteria.description: Name the concrete fault and distinct regression not already enforced statically.
Assert an independently expected public behavior or effect at the appropriate boundary.
Demonstrate the retained test fails for a plausible fault and passes after restoration.

limits: Recorded reviews and syntactic cases do not prove semantic value, independence, or actual mutation sensitivity.
The native generator covers explicit Python CLI contracts only; other test methods use native project tools.
